title: A backslash makes the next character literal: "\QQ yyyy" gives "Q1 2019"

source.quote: Use a backslash (\) to display the next character
source.supports: the example shows "Date (Q)", FORMAT ( DATE ( 2019, 3, 28 ), "\QQ yyyy" ) as Q1 2019

source.quote: Display the quarter of the year as a number (1-4).
